topic: strange things your body does while you sleep
title: Your Body Paralyzes You Every Night 😳
description: Every night your body paralyzes you, washes your brain and makes you taller — and you never notice. Which one surprised you most?

lines.text: Every night, your body paralyzes you, and that's not even the weirdest part.
While you dream, your brain switches off almost every muscle, so you don't act out your dreams.
It also gives itself a bath. Fluid flushes out the waste your brain made all day.
You wake up about a centimeter taller, because the discs in your spine refill overnight.
Your nose goes off duty. Smoke rarely wakes a sleeping person, which is why smoke alarms are so loud.
And that falling jolt as you drift off? It's a hypnic jerk, a muscle twitch, not a fall.
